# Tooltip

A short hint on hover or focus.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Hover-only hints fail touch, magnifier and keyboard users.</p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A brief name or hint for a control that already has an accessible name.
- **Not when:** The only place values or important words live, or touch screens, where hover never happens.

Instead:

- [Popover](./popover.md): Opens on click and works on touch.
- Hover card: A richer preview.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An icon with no label</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Not used: always add a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon button</div></div><div class="cap">Icons alone are guesswork.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape hides it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It describes its trigger and also shows on keyboard focus. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add tooltip
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay/background` | Fill of a dialog, menu or toast. | `color.surface.raised` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.raised` → `color.gray.light.0` | `color.surface.raised` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.raised` → `color.gray.dark.100` |
| `overlay/radius` | Corner radius of overlays. | `radius.container` → `accessible-first.theme.base.radius.container` → `radius.8` | same |
| `overlay/shadow` | Shadow of overlays. | `elevation.overlay` → `accessible-first.theme.light.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.none` | `elevation.overlay` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.none` |
| `overlay/scrim` | Color that dims the page behind a dialog. | `color.surface.scrim` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.light.scrim` | `color.surface.scrim` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.dark.scrim` |
| `overlay/item-height` | Height of a menu item. | `size.control.default` → `size.52` | same |
| `tooltip/background` | Tooltip fill. | `color.surface.inverse` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.inverse` → `color.gray.light.900` | `color.surface.inverse` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.inverse` → `color.gray.dark.900` |
| `tooltip/label` | Tooltip text. | `color.text.inverse` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.text.inverse` → `color.gray.light.0` | `color.text.inverse` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.text.inverse` → `color.gray.dark.50` |
